system.description: When you summon an Arcanum during your turn, choose up to two options: reduce its MP cost by (SL × 5); and/or after summoning, if merged, perform its pulse. If you choose at least one option, you cannot willingly dismiss that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both, that Arcanum's dismiss effect is unavailable during this summoning.
